**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5d.3 (R-2.5.3) · §5b.4
(`R-2.3.4¹`) · §7.1 (R-2.11.1 C1/Stage-2 slice)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/041_S2.10__tool-scaling.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.5.3 · R-2.3.4¹**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.9` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·

## Summary

The C1 tool-scaling halves land as **pure scorers over the S1 catalog**
(D1): `lexical_regex` (closed-subset ε-closure NFA, `hh-compiler::regex`),
`bm25` (token overlap + IDF over catalog statistics) and `hierarchical`
(prefix-depth descent over `namespace ∥ name`) all share one filtered
candidate set — non-`hidden`, structured filters applied uniformly —
so a variant changes ranking, never the contract. `discover` stays
bounded (`min(limit, max_reveal_per_search)`, default 8 / ceiling 32)
and honest (`truncated`, typed `DiscoveryQueryInvalid`). Under
`freeze`, a `list_changed` emits `action.tool.catalog.delta` without
moving `catalog_id`/`configuration_version_id`, and removed surfaces
refuse `SurfaceUnavailable` (AC-R-2.5.3-8 freeze half); the `adopt`
machinery lands for its S4 gate. `retrieval_eval` reports
`recall@k`/`nDCG@k` per query — the `exact_name` baseline floor is the
only gated number (AC-R-2.5.3-11).

The **K4 tool-result cache** lands as `Memory{kind: tool_result}` over
the C0 `MemoryStore` — no second store; lifecycle, supersession,
scope-ended expiry and the `resolve(mode = execute)` filter apply
unmodified (D3). The `entry_key` pins `(capability version, canonical
args, environment_stamp(env_ref, mutation_epoch), readers)`; the bound
name omits the epoch so post-mutation lookups are `stale_withheld`,
never silent misses (IR-3). `note_committed` bumps the epoch on
`{fs_write, exec, net_egress, spawn_process}` commits — conservative
over-invalidation is the declared trade. Served hits carry
`Origin::Cache{entry_ref}` — minted at the `environment` ceiling,
authority copied verbatim from the entry's label (I-NOAUTH's cache
face, D2); a malformed entry is `refused{malformed_entry}`, never a
partial serve. Every lookup emits exactly one `model.cache.resolved`
(`hit`/`miss`/`bypass`/`stale_withheld`/`refused`), and a hit produces
`prepared`/`observed`/`completed` terminals with **no**
`action.tool.started`/`committed` — a cache serve is distinguishable
from an execution in the ledger by construction.

The **CLI Stage-2 slice** lands: the `SurfacePreset` MUST-data table
(`plan`/`auto-edit`/`bypass`; `yolo` refused) lowering to
`approval_mode` + narrowing leaves whose ids are a
`policy_fingerprint` leg — a preset change revokes leases by
construction (D4); the bypass gate twice (CLI pre-ledger UX gate,
fail-closed; kernel `open_session` re-check against recorded
`containment.enforcement_evidence`, `bypass_admissible` durable on the
manifest); `workspace_trust` as a recorded claim from the user trust
store (`$HH_TRUST_STORE`/`~/.hh/trust.json`), `unknown` on
absent/malformed, never inferred from content (D5);
`amend(attendance|approval_mode)` with widening gates on the
*invoking* session's attendance and lease revocation (D8 — closes
DF-S1.26-1); the `env` verbs (`status`/`meters`/`list-detached` over
`describe`/`read`; `snapshot`/`derive`/`set-phase` as Group-M ops that
**keep the takeover writer session open** — `close` would drain the
run, D6; `derive` never exposes the child handle id — R-NOSIDE);
`config explain` rendering the `flags > env > project > user >
packaged` precedence per key; and `compact` as a stamped
declared-lossy `ViewKind::Compact` projection with its
`LoweringLossReport` (D7) on `compact <run_id>` and
`run inspect --view compact`.

Unbacked `env` verbs (`open`/`attach`/`close`/`diff`/`restore`/
`upload`/`download`) refuse a typed `stage_pending` — never faked
(DF-S2.10-1). AC-R-2.11.1-16's readers-withholding half stays with its
owning ticket S2.12 (DF-S2.10-2).

### `crates/hh-compiler`

- **`exposure.rs`** — `CatalogIndex::{LexicalRegex,Bm25,Hierarchical}`
  + `variant_hits` (shared filter then score); `catalog_delta` +
  `adopt`; reveal-retention expiry under `RevealBoundary`.
- **`regex.rs`** — the closed regex subset's ε-closure NFA `is_match`.
- **`retrieval.rs`** — `retrieval_eval` (recall@k/nDCG@k, per-query
  errors recorded, exact-name floor gated).

### `crates/hh-context`

- **`k4.rs` (new)** — `K4Cache` over `MemoryStore`: `K4Key`
  (`entry_key`/`member_name`), `MUTATION_DOMAINS`, epoch/capability
  dependency stamps, admissibility gate, `resolve` → `K4Resolution`
  (`Hit{version: Box<MemoryVersion>}`/`Miss`/`StaleWithheld`/`Refused`),
  `served_provenance` (`cache(entry_ref)` + entry label), the
  `model.cache.resolved` payload builder.
- **`memory.rs`/`vocab`** — `MemoryKind::ToolResult`,
  `DependencyKind::EnvironmentEpoch` stamp plumbing.

### `crates/hh-env`

- **`dispatch.rs`** — K4 lookup ahead of the executor + deposit after;
  `DispatchOutcome::ObservedCached` (boxed observation + provenance);
  `emit_cache_resolved` — one row per lookup.
- **`capture.rs`/`observe.rs`/`driver.rs`/`handle.rs`** — the
  observation rebuild path for served entries, mutation-domain
  bookkeeping, the `fs_tree`/derive surfaces the env ops consume.

### `crates/hh-provenance`

- **`origin.rs`/`decode.rs`/`record.rs`** — `Origin::Cache{entry_ref}`
  (`"cache"` tag, canonical codec round-trip), `default_authority_in`
  ceiling `environment`, `default_text_authority` cap `external`.

### `crates/hh-embed` / `crates/hh-embed-schema` / `crates/hh-codegen`

- **`envops.rs` (new)** — `env.snapshot` (fs_tree over the writer
  session's env, `instrument`-charged), `env.derive`
  (four derivation kinds, `scope`, `on_parent_end`; handle ids never
  escape), `env.set_phase` (fail-closed `phase_schedule_undeclared`).
- **`open.rs`** — `OpenSpec::New` carries `workspace_trust` +
  `narrowing_leaves`; the kernel-side `bypass_gate`; the manifest's
  `containment{bypass_admissible, enforcement_evidence}` block;
  realized settings rebuilt from the manifest on resume/attach.
- **`work.rs`** — `amend_policy` (attendance/approval_mode with the
  widening gates + lease revocation); `"compact"` → `ViewKind::Compact`.
- **`ops.rs`** — `env.snapshot`/`env.derive`/`env.set_phase`
  `implemented: true`; **`types.rs`** — `"compact"` in
  `PROJECT_VIEW_KINDS`; **`emit.rs`** — JSON-typed params pass
  `params.clone()` in the generated client.

### `crates/hh-cli`

- **`presets.rs` (new)** — the `SurfacePreset` table + leaf ids +
  the fail-closed containment-evidence preview.
- **`trust.rs` (new)** — the `workspace_trust` claim reader.
- **`cli.rs`** — `env` noun (six backed verbs + the `stage_pending`
  catch-all), `compact`, `config explain`, `run inspect --view
  compact`, `--preset`/`--bypass` wiring, `run amend` target plumbing.
- **`invocation.rs`/`boundary.rs`** — invocation/env plumbing for the
  trust store and the takeover-session env ops.
